title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of Cantagda in the Municipality of Cajidiocan, Province of Romblon
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of Cantagda in the Municipality of Cajidiocan, Province of Romblon
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Barrio Cantagda tại Đô thị Cajidiocan, Tỉnh Romblon

title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Barrio Cantagda di Kotamadya Cajidiocan, Provinsi Romblon

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3384_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Cantagda in the barrio of Danao, Municipality of Cajidiocan, Province of Romblon, is separated from said barrio and converted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality, to be known as the barrio of Cantagda.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
